Calvin: Hey Dave! Met with the creative team for my album yesterday. It was a long session, but awesome to see everything coming together. 
[S8T1] (dia_id: D8:1)

Dave: Hey Cal! Sounds great that your album's coming along. Are you feeling good about it? Here's a pic I just took.
[Image caption: a photography of a pond with a boat in it surrounded by trees]
[S8T2] (dia_id: D8:2)

Calvin: Dave, thanks for checking in. I'm feeling stoked about this album! We've been making some magic with a team in the studio, working on the music and everything. Look at what a wonderful studio we have! How have you been? Anything new since we talked?
[Image caption: a photo of a recording studio with a large window and a desk]
[S8T3] (dia_id: D8:3)

Dave: Hey, nice photo of the studio! Working in a team yields incredible results, well done! Keep pushing it! I've been doing good - thanks for asking. I've been exploring some parks on the weekends to relax - it's so peaceful being surrounded by nature. Are there any chill spots you enjoy in Boston?
[S8T4] (dia_id: D8:4)

Calvin: Thanks! That studio is great for creativity. I've never been to Boston before, but I hear the parks are amazing. Can't wait to visit next month. Anything cool you remember about Boston parks?
[Image caption: a photo of a tree with pink flowers in the foreground]
[S8T5] (dia_id: D8:5)

Dave: That sounds great! The Boston parks are awesome, especially in spring. It's so serene when you're walking around. I went for a stroll last Friday and it was amazing. It's so magical - I bet you'll love it! I love taking walks on the weekends, they recharge me for the entire upcoming week!
[S8T6] (dia_id: D8:6)

Calvin: I'm excited to experience that serenity. I can't wait to take a walk in the parks and recharge. Hey, have you been on any hikes lately?
[Image caption: a photo of a path going up a hill with a view of the mountains]
[S8T7] (dia_id: D8:7)

Dave: Nah, haven't gone hiking recently, but it's awesome - being in nature and pushing yourself to new heights. Clears your mind and brings a sense of calm. Have you been to the mountains before? Heard they're super chill.
[S8T8] (dia_id: D8:8)

- On 2023-10-25, shared a photo of himself performing at a nightclub (a DJ at a DJ table in a nightclub) with someone he admires — "So amazing!" (Dave: "You looked super comfortable on stage. Bet it was an incredible experience to perform with someone you admire. How did it feel being up there?") (Dave's side in the Relationships section of /memories/dave.md) [S26T7][S26T8]. Calvin: performing "with someone I admire" was "unreal" — "a dream come true" — and the energy and the crowd made him realize how much music means to him — "it's like my passion and my purpose" (complements his long-stated "fuels my soul"/concerts-are-what-he-lives-for remarks above; closing exchange details in the 2023-10-25 entry of ## Relationships) [S26T9].
- On 2023-10-29, told Dave that since they last talked he went to a networking event to meet more artists — "so cool!" — and that the people he met will help him build up his fan base — "super excited about what it could lead to." (an active step in his plan to expand his brand and grow his fanbase — see the 2023-08-03 entry above; Dave's side in the Relationships section of /memories/dave.md) [S27T1].
- On 2023-10-29, when Dave asked for music updates ("How's everything with the music? Any updates?"): Calvin said he'd had some great collaborations recently ("I've had some great collaborations recently") and his album is almost finished ("my album is almost finished") — a follow-up to the album that dropped 2023-09-11 (see above) — and promised he'll send Dave some previews soon ("I'll send you some previews soon"; Dave: "Cool, Calvin! Can't wait to hear it.") [S27T10][S27T11][S27T12].
- On 2023-11-02, told Dave that last week (~2023-10-26) he threw a small party at his Japanese mansion (see ## New home (2023-03-23)) for his new album — "It was amazing, so much love from my fam and friends!" (the 2023-10-29 update above had his album at "almost finished") — and shared photos of the party: a group of people sitting in a room with a projector screen ("Take a look at the photo of the party in the mansion, it was so energizing!"), a group of people dancing at the party, and a group of people standing on top of a stage [S28T1][S28T3][S28T5].
- On 2023-11-02, when Dave asked what it was like when everyone was cheering him on: "It was incredible, Dave! The room was buzzing with energy and love. It was a powerful reminder of why I'm doing this." [S28T4][S28T5].
- On 2023-11-02, said creating something that people connect with and brings joy "is what I'm all about," and moments like the party "really motivate me to keep growing!" (complements his earlier "passion and purpose" remark of 2023-10-25, see above) [S28T7].

Calvin: Hey Dave! Sorry it took me so long to get back to you. Crazy times since we talked! My album finally dropped on the 11th and it was a wild feeling. Everyone's been loving it and it's motivated me to keep going.
[S18T1] (dia_id: D18:1)

Dave: Hey Calvin! Congrats on your album release - that's awesome! Has it been overwhelming or inspiring?
[S18T2] (dia_id: D18:2)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! It's been a lot. Seeing everyone get behind it has been awesome. It's kinda overwhelming to think so many appreciate it. It's also cool that it's connecting with people. It really motivates me to make even better music.
[S18T3] (dia_id: D18:3)

Dave: That's awesome, Calvin! It's such a great feeling when your work gets noticed and makes a positive difference. It must be really motivating for you to keep chasing your dreams.
[S18T4] (dia_id: D18:4)

Calvin: Yeah, moments like this remind me why I got into music - making a difference and sharing my own story. It's exciting to get positive feedback and it gives me strength to keep going and reach more people. My journey's just getting started!
[S18T5] (dia_id: D18:5)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! You've come a long way since we started talking music. What's next for you? Anything exciting coming up?
[S18T6] (dia_id: D18:6)

- On 2023-05-03, said he's stuck with his music — "like [his] creativity's frozen" — and asked Dave for tips; said he'll take Dave's advice (take a break from music and explore other things for fun) to get his "mojo" back, and affirmed he won't give up on his music [S5T10][S5T11][S5T12][S5T14].
- On 2023-05-16, "super excited" for the Tokyo performance happening this month (May 2023) — a chance to show his music to a whole new crowd and hopefully expand his following (details in ## Tokyo trip) [S6T11]. The tour went ahead: as of 2023-05-31 he had been touring with Frank Ocean the week before (see ## Tokyo trip) [S7T1].
- As of 2023-06-09, has an album in progress ("my album"); met with the creative team for it on 2023-06-08 — "a long session, but awesome to see everything coming together", and he's "feeling stoked" and "making some magic" in the studio working on the music and everything. He shared a photo of the studio (a recording studio with a large window and a desk) [S8T1][S8T3].
- On 2023-05-31, said performing live "always fuels my soul" — he loves "the rush and connection with the crowd," "the feeling's indescribable — it's an absolute high"; at a concert "Everyone is part of it, it's like one big harmony." The chat came with concert photos (a large crowd taking pictures of a concert; a crowd watching a concert with bright lights; a band performing on stage) [S7T10][S7T11][S7T12][S7T13][S7T14].
- As of 2023-07-07, is working on music collaborations with Japanese artists and promised Dave he'll share clips when everything's ready (details in ## Japan plan) [S10T12][S10T14].

Calvin: Hey Dave! It's been a while! Crazy stuff has been happening. Last week I threw a small party at my Japanese house for my new album. It was amazing, so much love from my fam and friends! Take a look at the photo of the party in the mansion, it was so energizing!
[Image caption: a photography of a group of people sitting in a room with a projector screen]
[S28T1] (dia_id: D28:1)

Dave: Congrats on your album release and the party, Calvin! Must've been a great feeling having your loved ones show their support.
[S28T2] (dia_id: D28:2)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! It was an awesome feeling seeing everyone come together to celebrate - super rewarding! Look at this photo showcasing how wonderfully we spent our time!
[Image caption: a photography of a group of people dancing at a party]
[S28T3] (dia_id: D28:3)

Dave: Wow, great job, Calvin! Congrats! What was it like when everyone was cheering you on?
[S28T4] (dia_id: D28:4)

Calvin: It was incredible, Dave! The room was buzzing with energy and love. It was a powerful reminder of why I'm doing this.
[Image caption: a photo of a group of people standing on top of a stage]
[S28T5] (dia_id: D28:5)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! Creating something that brings people together and inspires them - that's really awesome!
[S28T6] (dia_id: D28:6)

- On 2023-08-31, reconnected with Calvin ("Long time no chat!"): Dave asked how the end of the tour was ("I bet it was amazing!"), and Calvin said the tour was amazing — "so pumped from all the energy from the audience" — sharing a photo of a crowd watching a concert with a large screen; Dave: "Wow, that looks amazing!" and asked how it was performing on that big stage; Calvin: "a dream come true", "on top of the world", "seriously surreal"; Dave: "Wow, that must have been an incredible experience! Congrats on achieving such an awesome moment!"; Calvin said he'd started shooting a video for his new album the weekend before (~2023-08-25/26), sharing a photo of a camera and a video camera on a beach; Dave: "Can't wait to see it", and asked "Will it be shot on location?"; Calvin: the shoot is in Miami, on an awesome beach — "It's going to have some epic visuals!"; the conversation continued with Dave saying the Miami beaches are awesome and that he can't wait to see them, and Calvin saying he loves the Miami vibe, it's "perfect for the vid", and "can't wait to show you!"; Dave was excited to see the vibe and location and offered to help with props or anything else for the video ("I'm here to support you!" / "let me know when, I'm here to lend a hand. It's great to fuel your ideas."); Calvin thanked him, said he'll let Dave know if he needs any assistance with props or anything else, and "Your support is much appreciated." The chat then turned to the photo Dave had sent once of Calvin's custom guitar with an octopus on it — Dave: "Love how this guitar shows our different artistic styles." — and Calvin explained he had it custom made by his Japanese artist friend, that the octopus represents his love for art and the sea, and that it's one of his favorites; Dave: "That's a great guitar, Calvin! Love the design, it's so unique and special.", and Calvin: "Cheers, mate! Really appreciate it. This guitar means so much to me; it's a reminder of my passion for music and the amazing friendships I've made."; Dave: "Wow, Calvin, this instrument obviously means a lot to you - it's like a representation of your journey, your passion for music, and the friendships you've made. Amazing!"; Calvin: "It's like every mark and strum holds a story", sharing a photo of the guitar with a purple glow; Dave marveled at the "gorgeous purple hue" and asked why it is so shiny, and Calvin said he had it customized with a shiny finish because it gives it a unique look and goes with his style; Dave: "Good pick!" and "Looks great on you! Your unique style really stands out in your music and playing."; Calvin: "Thanks, dude! I dig how it's so unique. It's totally my style!", and said that staying true to himself and being unique in his music is something he values, so it's great that Dave appreciates it; Dave then affirmed — "Definitely, staying true to yourself and your style is vital. It makes you unique and your music stand out. Keep it real, bud. You've got something great to give the world." — and re-shared, in that message, a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage (matches the photo of his shop work he shared on 2023-05-03 — see ## Car maintenance shop) (Calvin's side in the Music video and Octopus guitar sections of /memories/calvin.md) [S16T1][S16T2][S16T3][S16T4][S16T5][S16T6][S16T7][S16T8][S16T9][S16T10][S16T11][S16T12][S16T13][S16T14][S16T15][S16T16][S16T17][S16T18][S16T19][S16T20][S16T21][S16T22][S16T23][S16T24][S16T25].
- On 2023-09-02, reconnected with Calvin ("Hey Calvin! Been a while, what's up?"): said he's been "tied up with car stuff lately" and came back from San Francisco the day before (2023-09-01) with "some great insights and knowledge on car modification" he wants to share with Calvin — "Changing things around, and giving an old car a new life - so satisfying!" (details in ## Car workshops in San Francisco); he said fixing stuff up is "really rewarding and gives me a sense of purpose", that fixing someone's car feels like making a difference, and that seeing their relief when their car is fixed "makes me proud!" (details in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose); Calvin understood the satisfaction of giving things a new life and said Dave must feel great making a real difference — "like being their superhero!" — and should be proud [S17T1][S17T2][S17T3][S17T4][S17T5]. Calvin then said he booked a flight to Boston last week (~2023-08-26 through 09-01) and is so excited about the upcoming trip, sharing a photo of a book with a boarding pass on it (Calvin's side in the Boston trip section of /memories/calvin.md); Dave: "Cool! Let me know when you're free and we can catch up in Boston."; Calvin: "I'll let you know when I'm in Boston. See you soon!" [S17T6][S17T7][S17T8]. The chat then closed with Dave: "Looking forward to seeing you! Have a safe trip, see ya!" — looking forward to seeing Calvin in Boston and wishing him a safe trip [S17T9]; Calvin thanked him, reciprocated the safe-trip wishes ("Gotta stay safe on the trip"), said "Can't wait to see you there!", and promised he will contact Dave when he arrives [S17T10].
- On 2023-09-13, reconnected with Calvin, who apologized for the slow reply ("Crazy times since we talked!"): Calvin announced his album finally dropped on 2023-09-11 ("a wild feeling") and that everyone's been loving it (details in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md); Dave: "Congrats on your album release - that's awesome! Has it been overwhelming or inspiring?"; Calvin said it's been a lot — "kinda overwhelming to think so many appreciate it" — but cool that it's connecting with people, and it motivates him to make even better music; Dave: "That's awesome, Calvin! It's such a great feeling when your work gets noticed and makes a positive difference. It must be really motivating for you to keep chasing your dreams."; Calvin: such moments remind him why he got into music — making a difference and sharing his own story — and the positive feedback gives him strength to keep going and reach more people, "My journey's just getting started!"; Dave: "Wow, Calvin! You've come a long way since we started talking music. What's next for you? Anything exciting coming up?"; Calvin: "Lots of cool stuff happening. Next up, a tour - so excited! After that, I'm off to explore and grow my brand. Can't wait to see what the future has in store!" (tour and brand details in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md); Dave: "Wow, Calvin! Congrats on the upcoming tour! Can't wait to see you perform. Do you have any cities or venues in mind?" — Calvin did not answer that question in this exchange [S18T1][S18T2][S18T3][S18T4][S18T5][S18T6][S18T7][S18T8].
- The 2023-09-13 conversation continued: Calvin got excited about the tour stops — "We're hitting some awesome spots - it's gonna be epic!"; Dave said live music is the best and was sure Calvin would have a blast on tour and make awesome memories ("Keep rockin'!"), and offered to show Calvin around his garage and its cool cars (renewing his long-standing offer to show Calvin some cars when he comes to Boston — details in ## Boston; Calvin's side in the Boston trip section of /memories/calvin.md); Dave shared a photo of the garage (a car in a garage with a Coca-Cola sign) — "Check out pic of my garage, it looks stunning!" — and said "Can't wait for your visit! Take care and keep creating amazing music!"; Calvin accepted the offer ("I'll definitely take you up on that offer") and re-pledged to let Dave know when he's in Boston; the chat closed with mutual goodbyes — Dave: "Thanks again for your help. Bye! Have a great day." and "Catch you later", and Calvin: "No problem! Always good chatting with you. Have an awesome day!" [S18T9][S18T10][S18T11][S18T12][S18T13][S18T14][S18T15][S18T16].
- On 2023-09-15, reconnected with Calvin ("Hey Calvin! Long time no talk!"): told him the night before (2023-09-14) was a blast — he and his band were jamming, "the music just kept flowing," and "had so much fun rehearsing" — and shared that he had attended a rock concert in Boston last weekend (~2023-09-09/10) with an "amazing atmosphere" (photo of a band performing on stage with bright lights) (details in ## Rock band and ## Music); Calvin asked whether there were recordings, but Dave: "I wish we had recorded the jam, but we were way too into it and totally forgot" — Calvin: "Aww, bummer! I would've loved to hear that music," adding that "some of the best memories can't be captured on video or audio" — "those special moments that stay in our hearts and minds" — and then shared a Ratatouille Disney poster (photo of a Disney movie poster with a chef); Dave: "Wow, that's a gorgeous poster!" — it reminded him of one of his favorite Disney movies (implied to be Ratatouille), "I love the lesson it teaches about following your dreams no matter what others say," and he asked whether Calvin had seen it (details in ## Movies); Calvin said Ratatouille is one of his favorites — "It's all about going after what you love, no matter what anyone says" — then brought up Dave's car hobby ("Last time we talked, you mentioned your car hobby - how's that going?"); Dave: "It's been awesome" — "Been restoring this vintage beauty" — and shared the final result photo (a man standing next to a classic car) (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)); Calvin: "Nice work, Dave! That looks amazing. Is it satisfying to see your hard work pay off?" [S19T1][S19T2][S19T3][S19T4][S19T5][S19T6][S19T7][S19T8]. Dave answered: "It's so satisfying to see this brought back to life," especially seeing people's reactions when they see the finished product — "makes all the hard work worth it" [S19T9]; Calvin: "Dave, it's awesome seeing people happy thanks to you! Fixing cars is such an art. You're inspiring - keep up the good work!" [S19T10]; Dave: "It means a lot that you appreciate what I do. I'm glad that I can make people happy and that's what I'm gonna keep doing." — and had to go, "I have a lot of work to do! Take care!" [S19T11]; the conversation closed with Calvin: "You're really talented, Dave. Keep making people happy and doing what you love. That's what it's all about. See you soon, have a nice one!" [S19T12].

Dave: Hey Calvin! Long time no chat! How was the end of your tour? I bet it was amazing!
[Image caption: a photo of a crowd of people at a concert with their hands in the air]
[S16T1] (dia_id: D16:1)

Calvin: Hey Dave! The tour was amazing! I was so pumped from all the energy from the audience. This pic totally captures how I felt. Such an amazing time!
[Image caption: a photo of a crowd of people watching a concert with a large screen]
[S16T2] (dia_id: D16:2)

Dave: Wow, that looks amazing! How was it performing on that big stage?
[S16T3] (dia_id: D16:3)

Calvin: Performing on such a big stage was a dream come true! The energy was incredible and I felt on top of the world. It was seriously surreal.
[S16T4] (dia_id: D16:4)

Dave: Wow, that must have been an incredible experience! Congrats on achieving such an awesome moment!
[S16T5] (dia_id: D16:5)

Calvin: Cool! Last weekend I started shooting a video for my new album - can't wait for you to check it out! Look how great it was!
[Image caption: a photo of a camera and a video camera on a beach]
[S16T6] (dia_id: D16:6)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! Can't wait to see it. Will it be shot on location?
[S16T7] (dia_id: D16:7)

Calvin: We're doing the shoot in Miami and picked an awesome beach. It's going to have some epic visuals!
[S16T8] (dia_id: D16:8)

Dave: Sounds great, Calvin! The beaches in Miami are awesome - can't wait to see them!
[S16T9] (dia_id: D16:9)

Calvin: Oh man, they are amazing! I love the Miami vibe, it's perfect for the vid. Can't wait to show you!
[S16T10] (dia_id: D16:10)

- On 2023-08-31, told Dave that last weekend (~2023-08-25/26) he started shooting a video for his new album (the album in progress since 2023-06-09, see ## Music) — "can't wait for you to check it out!" — and shared a photo of a camera and a video camera on a beach ("Look how great it was!"); Dave: "Can't wait to see it", and asked whether it will be shot on location [S16T6][S16T7].
- The shoot is in Miami, on an awesome beach — "It's going to have some epic visuals!" [S16T8].
- Dave loves the beaches in Miami and can't wait to see them; Calvin: "I love the Miami vibe, it's perfect for the vid. Can't wait to show you!" [S16T9][S16T10].

Calvin: Wow, that pic is amazing! In your last photo, is that the clock tower? I was there a few years back, it's such a beautiful city. You're so talented, Dave!
[S27T7] (dia_id: D27:7)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Your kind words mean a lot. Yep, that's the clock tower in the last photo. I snapped it at sunset and the colors were stunning. Photography helps me capture and appreciate the beauty of nature. It's been an awesome creative outlet and I'm loving it.
[S27T8] (dia_id: D27:8)

Calvin: Wow, Dave! Sounds like you're having a blast with your photography. Hope it's bringing you lots of joy. By the way, how is your car project going?
[S27T9] (dia_id: D27:9)

Dave: Hey Calvin, photography has been great for me! The car project is doing well - I just finished restoring it and it looks amazing. Wanna come by and check it out? How's everything with the music? Any updates?
[S27T10] (dia_id: D27:10)

Calvin: That's awesome, Dave! Your car project sounds amazing. I've had some great collaborations recently and my album is almost finished. I'll send you some previews soon. Let me know when you're free for a catch-up.
[S27T11] (dia_id: D27:11)

Dave: Cool, Calvin! Can't wait to hear it. Let me know when you're free and take it easy!
[S27T12] (dia_id: D27:12)

Calvin: Cheers! I'll let you know when I'm free. Bye!
[S27T13] (dia_id: D27:13)
